package screens // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/screens/screens"

Package screens is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package screens is a demo of the pane layouts and of quasi-fullscreen detection.
Full screen means the alternate screen, so switching between it and inline
keeps the scrollback clean; full screen on the primary screen is kept as a
demo-only layout. An inline pane that is grown, or whose terminal is shrunk,
to nearly the terminal height switches to the alternate screen by itself.
The app draws a border so its extent is visible.

FUNCTIONS

func Run(args []string) error
    Run parses args with cobra and runs the demo.


TYPES

type App struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    App is the demo widget. pane is nil in headless tests, where cfg and height
    stand in for the pane's state.

func NewApp(pane *loom.Pane, cfg loom.ResizeConfig, height int) *App
    NewApp returns an App wanting height inline rows, starting inline.

func (a *App) Config() loom.ResizeConfig
    Config returns the resize configuration the app drives.

func (a *App) ConsumeKey(e loom.KeyEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeKey handles the demo keys.

func (a *App) ConsumeMouse(e loom.MouseEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeMouse triggers the clicked button. Coordinates are pane-relative and
    1-based, so canvas coordinates are one less.

func (a *App) Draw(c *loom.Canvas, r loom.Rect)
    Draw renders the state into r.

func (a *App) SetTheme(name string) error
    SetTheme selects a spec theme by name.
